prompt:
An electric immersion heater is rated at 2.4 kW. It transfers 4.32 x 10^5 J of thermal energy to a water tank.
Calculate the time, in minutes, that the heater is switched on.

mark_scheme.criterion: Calculates time in seconds: t = E / P = (4.32 * 10^5) / 2400 = 180 s.

hints: Convert power from kilowatts to watts: 2.4 kW = 2400 W.
Use t = E / P to find time in seconds, then convert to minutes.
teacher_walkthrough: Check that units match: 2.4 kW = 2400 W = 2400 J s^-1.
